entities.summary: Leader of Sudan (1989–2019). 30-year Islamist military dictator; NCP/NIF (Hassan al-Turabi alliance then split); Darfur genocide; ICC warrant for crimes against humanity; South Sudan secession under his rule; ousted by April 2019
